improved_gouge.name: Improved Gouge
improved_gouge.tooltipTemplate: Increases the effect duration of your Gouge ability by [V1] sec.

improved_sinister_strike.name: Improved Sinister Strike
improved_sinister_strike.tooltipTemplate: Reduces the Energy cost of your Sinister Strike ability by [V1].

dual_wield_specialization.name: Dual Wield Specialization
dual_wield_specialization.tooltipTemplate: Increases the damage done by your off-hand weapon by [V1]%.

improved_slice_and_dice.name: Improved Slice and Dice
improved_slice_and_dice.tooltipTemplate: Increases the duration of your Slice and Dice ability by [V1]%.

precision.name: Precision
precision.tooltipTemplate: Increases your chance to hit with weapon and poison attacks by [V1]%.

endurance.name: Endurance
endurance.tooltipTemplate: Reduces the cooldown of your Sprint and Evasion abilities by [V1] sec and increases your total Stamina by [V2]%.

riposte.name: Riposte
riposte.tooltipTemplate: A strike that becomes active after parrying an opponent's attack.  This attack deals 150% weapon damage and slows their melee attack speed by 20% for 30 sec.  Awards 2 combo point.

close_quarters_combat.name: Close Quarters Combat
close_quarters_combat.tooltipTemplate: Increases your chance to get a critical strike with Daggers and Fist Weapons by [V1]%.

improved_kick.name: Improved Kick
improved_kick.tooltipTemplate: Gives your Kick ability a [V1]% chance to silence the target for 2 sec.

improved_sprint.name: Improved Sprint
improved_sprint.tooltipTemplate: Gives a [V1]% chance to remove all Movement Impairing effects when you activate your Sprint ability.

lightning_reflexes.name: Lightning Reflexes
lightning_reflexes.tooltipTemplate: Increases your Dodge chance by [V1]% and gives you [V2]% melee haste.

aggression.name: Aggression
aggression.tooltipTemplate: Increases the damage of your Sinister Strike, Backstab, and Eviscerate abilities by [V1]%.

mace_specialization.name: Mace Specialization
mace_specialization.tooltipTemplate: Your attacks with maces ignore up to [V1]% of your opponent's armor.

blade_flurry.name: Blade Flurry
blade_flurry.tooltipTemplate: Increases your attack speed by 20%.  In addition, attacks strike an additional nearby opponent.  Lasts 15 sec.

hack_and_slash.name: Hack and Slash
hack_and_slash.tooltipTemplate: Gives you a [V1]% chance to get an extra attack on the same target after hitting your target with your Sword or Axe.

blade_twisting.name: Blade Twisting
blade_twisting.tooltipTemplate: Increases the damage dealt by Sinister Strike and Backstab by [V1]%, and your damaging melee attacks have a 10% chance to Daze the target for [V2] sec.

vitality.name: Vitality
vitality.tooltipTemplate: Increases your Energy regeneration rate by [V1]%.

adrenaline_rush.name: Adrenaline Rush
adrenaline_rush.tooltipTemplate: Increases your Energy regeneration rate by 100% for 15 sec.

nerves_of_steel.name: Nerves of Steel
nerves_of_steel.tooltipTemplate: Reduces damage taken while affected by Stun and Fear effects by [V1]%.

throwing_specialization.name: Throwing Specialization
throwing_specialization.tooltipTemplate: Increases the range of Throw and Deadly Throw by [V1] yards and gives your Deadly Throw a [V2]% chance per combo point to interrupt the target for 3 sec.

combat_potency.name: Combat Potency
combat_potency.tooltipTemplate: Gives your successful off-hand melee attacks a 20% chance to generate [V1] Energy.

unfair_advantage.name: Unfair Advantage
unfair_advantage.tooltipTemplate: Whenever you dodge an attack you gain an Unfair Advantage, striking back for [V1]% of your main hand weapon's damage.  This cannot occur more than once per second.

surprise_attacks.name: Surprise Attacks
surprise_attacks.tooltipTemplate: Your finishing moves can no longer be dodged, and the damage dealt by your Sinister Strike, Backstab, Shiv, Hemorrhage and Gouge abilities is increased by 10%.

savage_combat.name: Savage Combat
savage_combat.tooltipTemplate: Increases your total attack power by [V1]% and all physical damage caused to enemies you have poisoned is increased by [V2]%.

prey_on_the_weak.name: Prey on the Weak
prey_on_the_weak.tooltipTemplate: Your critical strike damage is increased by [V1]% when the target has less health than you (as a percentage of total health).

killing_spree.name: Killing Spree
killing_spree.tooltipTemplate: Step through the shadows from enemy to enemy within 10 yards, attacking an enemy every 0.5 sec with both weapons until 5 assaults are made, and increasing all damage done by 40% for the duration.  Can hit the same target multiple times.  Cannot hit invisible or stealthed targets.

relentless_strikes.name: Relentless Strikes
relentless_strikes.tooltipTemplate: Your finishing moves have a [V1]% chance per combo point to restore 25 energy.

master_of_deception.name: Master of Deception
master_of_deception.tooltipTemplate: Reduces the chance enemies have to detect you while in Stealth mode.  More effective than Master of Deception (Rank 2).

opportunity.name: Opportunity
opportunity.tooltipTemplate: Increases the damage dealt with your Backstab, Mutilate, Garrote and Ambush abilities by [V1]%.

sleight_of_hand.name: Sleight of Hand
sleight_of_hand.tooltipTemplate: Reduces the chance you are critically hit by melee and ranged attacks by [V1]% and increases the threat reduction of your Feint ability by [V2]%.

dirty_tricks.name: Dirty Tricks
dirty_tricks.tooltipTemplate: Increases the range of your Blind and Sap abilities by [V1] yards and reduces the energy cost of your Blind and Sap abilities by [V2]%.

camouflage.name: Camouflage
camouflage.tooltipTemplate: Increases your speed while stealthed by [V1]% and reduces the cooldown of your Stealth ability by [V2] sec.

elusiveness.name: Elusiveness
elusiveness.tooltipTemplate: Reduces the cooldown of your Vanish and Blind abilities by [V1] sec and your Cloak of Shadows ability by [V2] sec.

ghostly_strike.name: Ghostly Strike
ghostly_strike.tooltipTemplate: A strike that deals 125% weapon damage (180% if a dagger is equipped) and increases your chance to dodge by 15% for 7 sec.  Awards 1 combo point.

serrated_blades.name: Serrated Blades
serrated_blades.tooltipTemplate: Causes your attacks to ignore up to [V1]% of your target's Armor and increases the damage dealt by your Rupture ability by [V2]%.

setup.name: Setup
setup.tooltipTemplate: Gives you a [V1]% chance to add a combo point to your target after dodging their attack or fully resisting one of their spells.  This cannot happen more than once per second.

initiative.name: Initiative
initiative.tooltipTemplate: Gives you a [V1]% chance to add an additional combo point to your target when using your Ambush, Garrote, or Cheap Shot ability.

improved_ambush.name: Improved Ambush
improved_ambush.tooltipTemplate: Increases the critical strike chance of your Ambush ability by [V1]%.

heightened_senses.name: Heightened Senses
heightened_senses.tooltipTemplate: Increases your Stealth detection and reduces the chance you are hit by spells and ranged attacks by 4%.  More effective than Heightened Senses (Rank 1).

preparation.name: Preparation
preparation.tooltipTemplate: When activated, this ability immediately finishes the cooldown on your Evasion, Sprint, Vanish, Cold Blood and Shadowstep abilities.

dirty_deeds.name: Dirty Deeds
dirty_deeds.tooltipTemplate: Reduces the Energy cost of your Cheap Shot and Garrote abilities by [V1].  Additionally, your special abilities cause [V2]% more damage against targets below 35% health.

hemorrhage.name: Hemorrhage
hemorrhage.tooltipTemplate: An instant strike that deals 110% weapon damage (159.5% if a dagger is equipped) and causes the target to hemorrhage, increasing any Physical damage dealt to the target by up to 13.  Lasts 10 charges or 15 sec.  Awards 1 combo point.

master_of_subtlety.name: Master of Subtlety
master_of_subtlety.tooltipTemplate: Attacks made while stealthed and for 6 seconds after breaking stealth cause an additional [V1]% damage.

enveloping_shadows.name: Enveloping Shadows
enveloping_shadows.tooltipTemplate: Reduces the damage taken by area of effect attacks by [V1]%.

premeditation.name: Premeditation
premeditation.tooltipTemplate: When used, adds 2 combo points to your target.  You must add to or use those combo points within 20 sec or the combo points are lost.

cheat_death.name: Cheat Death
cheat_death.tooltipTemplate: You have a [V1]% chance that an attack which would otherwise kill you will instead reduce you to 10% of your maximum health. In addition, all damage taken will be reduced by 90% for 3 sec. This effect cannot occur more than once every 90 seconds.

sinister_calling.name: Sinister Calling
sinister_calling.tooltipTemplate: Increases your total Agility by [V1]% and increases the percentage damage bonus of Backstab and Hemorrhage by an additional [V2]%.

waylay.name: Waylay
waylay.tooltipTemplate: Your Ambush and Backstab hits have a [V1]% chance to unbalance a target, increasing the time between their melee and ranged attacks by 20%, and reducing movement speed by 50% for 8 sec.

honor_among_thieves.name: Honor Among Thieves
honor_among_thieves.tooltipTemplate: When anyone in your group critically hits with a damage or healing spell or ability, you have a [V1]% chance to gain a combo point on your current target.  This effect cannot occur more than once every second.

shadowstep.name: Shadowstep
shadowstep.tooltipTemplate: Attempts to step through the shadows and reappear behind your enemy and increases movement speed by 70% for 3 sec.  The damage of your next ability is increased by 20% and the threat caused is reduced by 50%.  Lasts 10 sec.

filthy_tricks.name: Filthy Tricks
filthy_tricks.tooltipTemplate: Reduces the cooldown by [V1] sec and energy cost by [V2] of your Tricks of the Trade, Distract and Shadowstep abilities and reduces the cooldown of Preparation by [V3] min.

slaughter_from_the_shadows.name: Slaughter from the Shadows
slaughter_from_the_shadows.tooltipTemplate: Reduces the energy cost of your Backstab and Ambush abilities by [V1] and the energy cost of your Hemorrhage by [V2], and increases all damage done by [V3]%.

shadow_dance.name: Shadow Dance
shadow_dance.tooltipTemplate: Enter the Shadow Dance for 8 sec, allowing the use of Sap, Garrote, Ambush, Cheap Shot, Premeditation, Pickpocket and Disarm Trap regardless of being stealthed.

improved_eviscerate.name: Improved Eviscerate
improved_eviscerate.tooltipTemplate: Increases the damage done by your Eviscerate ability by [V1]%.

remorseless_attacks.name: Remorseless Attacks
remorseless_attacks.tooltipTemplate: After killing an opponent that yields experience or honor, gives you a [V1]% increased critical strike chance on your next Sinister Strike, Hemorrhage, Backstab, Mutilate, Ambush, or Ghostly Strike.  Lasts 20 sec.

malice.name: Malice
malice.tooltipTemplate: Increases your critical strike chance by [V1]%.

ruthlessness.name: Ruthlessness
ruthlessness.tooltipTemplate: Gives your melee finishing moves a [V1]% chance to add a combo point to your target.

blood_spatter.name: Blood Spatter
blood_spatter.tooltipTemplate: Increases the damage caused by your Garrote and Rupture abilities by [V1]%.

puncturing_wounds.name: Puncturing Wounds
puncturing_wounds.tooltipTemplate: Increases the critical strike chance of your Backstab ability by [V1]%, and the critical strike chance of your Mutilate ability by [V2]%.

improved_expose_armor.name: Improved Expose Armor
improved_expose_armor.tooltipTemplate: Reduces the energy cost of your Expose Armor ability by [V1].

lethality.name: Lethality
lethality.tooltipTemplate: Increases the critical strike damage bonus of all combo point-generating abilities that do not require stealth by [V1]%.

vile_poisons.name: Vile Poisons
vile_poisons.tooltipTemplate: Increases the damage dealt by your poisons and Envenom ability by [V1]% and gives your damage over time poisons an additional [V2]% chance to resist dispel effects.

improved_poisons.name: Improved Poisons
improved_poisons.tooltipTemplate: Increases the chance to apply Deadly Poison to your target by [V1]% and the frequency of applying Instant Poison to your target by [V2]%.

fleet_footed.name: Fleet Footed
fleet_footed.tooltipTemplate: Reduces the duration of all movement impairing effects by [V1]% and increases your movement speed by [V2]%.  This does not stack with other movement speed increasing effects.

mutilate.name: Mutilate
mutilate.tooltipTemplate: Instantly attacks with both weapons for 100% weapon damage plus an additional 34 with each weapon.  Damage is increased by 20% against Poisoned targets.  Awards 2 combo points.

improved_kidney_shot.name: Improved Kidney Shot
improved_kidney_shot.tooltipTemplate: While affected by your Kidney Shot ability, the target receives an additional [V1]% damage from all sources.

quick_recovery.name: Quick Recovery
quick_recovery.tooltipTemplate: All healing effects on you are increased by [V1]%.  In addition, your finishing moves refund [V2]% of their Energy cost when they fail to hit.

seal_fate.name: Seal Fate
seal_fate.tooltipTemplate: Your critical strikes from abilities that add combo points have a [V1]% chance to add an additional combo point.

deadly_brew.name: Deadly Brew
deadly_brew.tooltipTemplate: When you apply Instant, Wound or Mind-Numbing poison to a target, you have a [V1]% chance to apply Crippling poison.

overkill.name: Overkill
overkill.tooltipTemplate: While stealthed, and for 20 seconds after breaking stealth, you regenerate 30% additional energy.

focused_attacks.name: Focused Attacks
focused_attacks.tooltipTemplate: Your melee critical strikes have a [V1]% chance to give you 2 energy.

master_poisoner.name: Master Poisoner
master_poisoner.tooltipTemplate: Increases the critical hit chance of all attacks made against any target you have poisoned by [V1]%, reduces the duration of all Poison effects applied to you by [V2]%, and gives Envenom a [V3]% chance not to consume Deadly Poison.

cold_blood.name: Cold Blood
cold_blood.tooltipTemplate: When activated, increases the critical strike chance of your next offensive ability by 100%.

turn_the_tables.name: Turn the Tables
turn_the_tables.tooltipTemplate: Whenever anyone in your party or raid blocks, dodges, or parries an attack your chance to critically hit with all combo moves is increased by [V1]% for 8 sec.

cut_to_the_chase.name: Cut to the Chase
cut_to_the_chase.tooltipTemplate: Your Eviscerate, Envenom and Crimson Tempest abilities have a [V1]% chance to refresh your Slice and Dice duration to its 5 combo point maximum.

hunger_for_blood.name: Hunger For Blood
hunger_for_blood.tooltipTemplate: Enrages you, increasing all damage caused by 5%.  Requires a bleed effect to be active on the target.  Lasts 1 min.

enchants.name: Combat Readiness
enchants.tooltip:
Teaches you: Combat Readiness. 
Combat Readiness: Enter a state of heightened defensive awareness. Each time you're hit by a spell or ability you reduce your overall damage taken by 5% for 10 sec, stacking 5 times. Lasts 20 sec or until not attacked for 10 sec.

enchants.name: Grappling Hook
enchants.tooltip:
Teaches you: Grappling Hook. 
Grappling Hook: Launch a grappling hook and pull yourself to the target location.

enchants.name: Recuperate
enchants.tooltip:
Teaches you: Recuperate. 
Recuperate: Finishing move that consumes combo points on your target to restore 3% of health every 3 sec. Lasts longer per combo point:
   1 point : 6 seconds
   2 points: 12 seconds
   3 points: 18 seconds
   4 points: 24 seconds
   5 points: 30 seconds

Killing an opponent that yields experience or honor extends the duration of Recuperate to its 5 combo point maximum.
Killing an opponent that yields experience or honor extends the duration of Recuperate to its 5 combo point maximum.

enchants.name: Smoke Bomb
enchants.tooltip:
Teaches you: Smoke Bomb. 
Smoke Bomb: Creates a cloud of thick smoke in an 8 yard radius around you for 5 sec. Enemies are unable to target into or out of the smoke cloud.

enchants.name: Adrenaline Junkie
enchants.tooltip:
Requires Adrenaline Rush
Your finishing moves have a 20% chance per combo point to reduce the cooldown of Adrenaline Rush by 12 sec. In addition, Adrenaline Rush does not trigger a global cooldown.

enchants.name: Assassin's Rush
enchants.tooltip:
Requires Adrenaline Rush
Increases your attack speed by 10% and causes Adrenaline Rush to further increase your attack speed and movement speed by 20% while active.

enchants.name: Blade Vortex
enchants.tooltip:
Requires Blade Flurry
Your damaging melee finishing moves have a 20% chance per combo point to reduce the cooldown of Blade Flurry by 5 sec and while Blade Flurry is active to also create a Blade Vortex.

Damaging casts of Fan of Knives grants 1 combo point while Blade Flurry is active.
Blade Vortex: Deals 88.87 Physical damage to nearby enemies every second for 3 sec.

When triggered, increases the duration of Blade Flurry by 3 seconds.

enchants.name: Bleeding Edge
enchants.tooltip: You gain 4 energy whenever you deal bleed damage with Garrote or Rupture or instant damage with Crimson Tempest.

enchants.name: Blood-Soaked Mutilation
enchants.tooltip:
Requires Mutilate
Mutilate damage is increased by 6% for every active bleed effect that you have applied to the target.

Crimson Tempest has a 20% chance per combo point to allow Garrote to be used outside of stealth. When used this way Garrote does not trigger its silence effect.

enchants.name: Bloodshed
enchants.tooltip:
Requires Hunger For Blood
Using Hunger for Blood increases the damage of your Rogue bleed effects by 15% for 10 sec and causes the target to take 30% additional damage from bleed effects for 30 sec.

In addition, your Hunger for Blood has no energy cost and generates 10 energy when used.

@ext:The additional bleed damage taken does not stack with other similar effects.:ext@

enchants.name: Combat Proficiency
enchants.tooltip:
Requires Combat Potency
Increases your armor penetration by 10% and the chance to trigger the Combat Potency talent by 50%.

enchants.name: Dispatch
enchants.tooltip:
Teaches you: Dispatch. 
Dispatch: Finishing move that causes damage per combo point:
   1 point  : 54-78 damage
   2 points: 95-119 damage
   3 points: 136-160 damage
   4 points: 177-201 damage
   5 points: 218-242 damage

If used on a target below 35% health, your next Eviscerate or Envenom deals 20% increased damage. Dispatch does not consume combo points.

enchants.name: Energy Surge
enchants.tooltip:
Reduces the energy cost of Gouge by 20 and using Gouge on a monster doubles your energy regeneration while the Gouge lasts.

In addition, breaking Gouge with a damaging Rogue ability increases the damage of that ability by 30%.

enchants.name: Envenomed
enchants.tooltip: Deal 10% additional damage with poisons to bleeding targets. In addition, the energy cost of Envenom is reduced by 5.

enchants.name: Fatal Counter
enchants.tooltip:
Increases the damage of Riposte by 10%.

Killing an opponent that yields experience or honor allows one use of Riposte for 10 sec.

enchants.name: From the Shadows
enchants.tooltip:
Requires Shadow Dance
Backstab and Hemorrhage reduces the cooldown of Shadow Dance by 1 second.

Shadow Dance increases your damage done against creatures by 30%.

enchants.name: Hazardous Escape
Massacre
enchants.tooltip:
Requires Killing Spree
Killing Spree also deals 100% weapon damage to nearby enemies and applies Massacre to all targets hit. Dealing damage with Sinister Strike reduces the cooldown of Killing Spree by 0 sec.

Massacre: Damage done to the target from the Rogue is increased by 2%. Stacks up to 5 times and lasts for 30 sec.

enchants.name: Methodical Approach
enchants.tooltip: Dealing damage with Ambush reduces the energy cost of your next Eviscerate by 15 and causes it to increase the duration of Rupture by 8 sec.

enchants.name: Murder Rush
enchants.tooltip:
Requires Sprint
Killing an enemy that yields experience or honor gives you Sprint for 5 seconds. If Sprint is already active, its duration is fully refreshed. In addition, while Sprint is active you deal 10% more damage.

enchants.name: Natural Energy
enchants.tooltip:
Requires Mutilate
While Envenom is active the energy cost of your Mutilate is reduced by 7.

enchants.name: No Remorse
enchants.tooltip:
Requires Remorseless Attacks
Remorseless Attacks increases the critical strike chance of the ability by 100% and also reduces its energy cost by 50%.

enchants.name: Phantom Stab
enchants.tooltip:
Using Ghostly Strike increases the damage of your next Backstab by 10% and allows it to be used without being behind the target.

Using Backstab reduces the cooldown of Ghostly Strike by 0 sec.

enchants.name: Poison Bomb
enchants.tooltip:
Teaches you: Poison Bomb. 
Poison Bomb: Throw a Poison Bomb that unleashes deadly fumes, immediately applying a stack of Deadly Poison and an additional stack to nearby enemies every 2 seconds for 10 sec.

enchants.name: Prison Tactics
enchants.tooltip:
Your Shiv has a 8 second cooldown and dealing damage with Shiv extends the duration of your Adrenaline Rush by 6 seconds and grants you Prison Tactics.
Prison Tactics: Increases your attack speed by 20% for 4 seconds.

enchants.name: Repartee
enchants.tooltip: Reduces the cooldown of Feint by 4 seconds, and Feint enables the use of Riposte for 6 sec. Riposte has 20% increased critical strike chance when used this way.

enchants.name: Shadow of Death
Shattering Execution
enchants.tooltip: Your Eviscerate and Dispatch have a 20% chance per combo point to shatter your target's armor, allowing your attacks to ignore 8% (5% against players) its armor for 15 sec, stacking up to 5 times.

enchants.name: Sinister Finisher
enchants.tooltip:
Using Sinister Strike grants Sinister Finisher.

Sinister Finisher: Reduces the cost of your next Eviscerate by 10 and causes it to hit an additional nearby target for 15% of the damage dealt. Stacks up to 3 and lasts 12 seconds.

enchants.name: Veiled Wire
enchants.tooltip:
Requires Shadow Dance
While Shadow Dance is active your Garrote hits 4 nearby targets.

enchants.name: Venomous Edge
enchants.tooltip: Dealing damage with Envenom increases the critical strike chance of your combo point generating abilities by 3%. Stacks up to 3 times and lasts for 15 sec. In addition, using Kingsbane triggers Overkill (if learned).

enchants.name: Assassination Mastery
enchants.tooltip: Increases the damage of your Poisons by 8% and the damage of your Envenom by 5%.

enchants.name: Assuaging Shadows
enchants.tooltip:
Requires Shadow Dance
Using Shadow Dance causes a shadow eruption, slowing nearby enemies by 70% for 2 sec and applying 3 shadow marks.

Using Ambush on a marked enemy allows you to ignore the cooldown of Shadowstep for 2 sec and increases your damage done by 6% for 10 sec.

Using Shadowstep grants you 20 energy.

@ext:Only 1 mark is applied versus players.:ext@

enchants.name: Chasin' the Rush
enchants.tooltip: Your finishing moves have a 4% chance per combo point spent to grant you 20% energy regeneration and 20% attack speed for 10 sec.

enchants.name: Combat Mastery
enchants.tooltip: Your attacks penetrate through 12% of the target's armor.

enchants.name: Crimson Hunger
enchants.tooltip:
Crimson Tempest deals 50% increased damage to your main target. 

When Wound Poison strikes a bleeding enemy, it deals additional bleed damage and puts you into a Crimson Hunger.

Crimson Hunger: Increases the damage of your Rogue bleeds by 2% for 20 sec seconds, stacking up to 30 times.

enchants.name: Festering Wound
enchants.tooltip:
Requires Mutilate
Your Mutilate critical strikes apply Festering Wound. In addition, your Deadly Poison can stack up to 8 and your Envenom damage is increased by 5% for each stack above 5.
Festering Wound: Increases your Nature damage dealt to the target by 1%. Stacks up to 5 times and lasts 10 sec.

enchants.name: Kingsbane
enchants.tooltip:
Teaches you: Kingsbane. 
Kingsbane: Release a lethal poison from your weapons and inject it into your target, dealing 132.32 Nature damage instantly and 1415.98 additional Nature damage over 12 sec.

Each time you apply a Deadly, Instant or Wound Poison to a target affected by your Kingsbane, its damage increases by 10%.

Awards 3 combo point.

enchants.name: Roll the Bones
enchants.tooltip:
Teaches you: Roll the Bones. 
Roll the Bones: Roll the dice of fate, providing 1, 2, 3 or when in great luck, 5 random combat enhancements. Lasts longer per combo point:
  1 point  : 6 seconds
  2 points: 12 seconds
  3 points: 18 seconds
  4 points: 24 seconds
  5 points: 30 seconds

enchants.name: Rush of Blood
enchants.tooltip:
Requires Hemorrhage
Ambush has no positional requirement versus monsters and costs 10 less energy. 

Using Hemorrhage twice in a row makes your next Ambush usable outside Stealth. Using Hemorrhage a third time regenerates 30 energy. Using any other ability resets the sequence.

enchants.name: Shadow Blades
enchants.tooltip:
Teaches you: Shadow Blades. 
Shadow Blades: Draws upon surrounding shadows to empower your weapons, causing your direct damaging melee combo point generating abilities to generate an additional combo point and deal 15% additional damage as Shadow for 15 sec. Does not break stealth.

enchants.name: Sinister Flurry
enchants.tooltip: Your Sinister Strike has a 33% chance to trigger an additional strike which deals 75% weapon damage, awards an additional combo point and generates 10 energy.

enchants.name: Subtlety Mastery
enchants.tooltip: Increases the damage done by your Ambush, Backstab, Hemorrhage and finishing moves by 6%.

enchants.name: Aggression
enchants.tooltip:
Crossover Talent
Increases the damage of your Sinister Strike, Backstab, and Eviscerate abilities by 15%.

This Mystic Enchant does not stack with the Aggression Talent.

enchants.name: Blood Spatter
enchants.tooltip:
Crossover Talent
Increases the damage caused by your Garrote and Rupture abilities by 30%.

This Mystic Enchant does not stack with the Blood Spatter Talent.

enchants.name: Camouflage
enchants.tooltip:
Crossover Talent
Increases your speed while stealthed by 15% and reduces the cooldown of your Stealth ability by 6 sec.

This Mystic Enchant does not stack with the Camouflage Talent.

enchants.name: Close Quarters Combat
enchants.tooltip:
Crossover Talent
Increases your chance to get a critical strike with Daggers and Fist Weapons by 5%.

This Mystic Enchant does not stack with the Close Quarters Combat Talent.

enchants.name: Deflection
enchants.tooltip:
Crossover Talent
Increases your Parry chance by 6%.

This Mystic Enchant does not stack with the Deflection Talent.

enchants.name: Dirty Tricks
enchants.tooltip:
Crossover Talent
Increases the range of your Blind and Sap abilities by 5 yards and reduces the energy cost of your Blind and Sap abilities by 50%.

This Mystic Enchant does not stack with the Dirty Tricks Talent.

enchants.name: Doppelganger
enchants.tooltip: Your Vanish now spawns a Doppelganger that looks like you and runs in a random direction, taking the hits so you can get away. Lasts 4 seconds.

enchants.name: Dual Wield Specialization
enchants.tooltip:
Crossover Talent
Increases the damage done by your off-hand weapon by 50%.

This Mystic Enchant does not stack with the Dual Wield Specialization Talent.

enchants.name: Elusiveness
enchants.tooltip:
Crossover Talent
Reduces the cooldown of your Vanish and Blind abilities by 60 sec and your Cloak of Shadows ability by 30 sec.

This Mystic Enchant does not stack with the Elusiveness Talent.

enchants.name: Endurance
enchants.tooltip:
Crossover Talent
Reduces the cooldown of your Sprint and Evasion abilities by 60 sec and increases your total Stamina by 4%.

This Mystic Enchant does not stack with the Endurance Talent.

enchants.name: Glyph of Adrenaline Rush
enchants.tooltip: Increases the duration of Adrenaline Rush by 5 sec.

enchants.name: Glyph of Ambush
enchants.tooltip: Increases the range on Ambush by 5 yards and its critical damage by 15%.

enchants.name: Glyph of Backstab
enchants.tooltip: Your Backstab increases the duration of your Rupture effect on the target by 2 seconds, up to a maximum of 8 additional seconds.

enchants.name: Glyph of Blade Flurry
enchants.tooltip: Reduces the energy cost of Blade Flurry by 100%.

enchants.name: Glyph of Cloak of Shadows
enchants.tooltip: While Cloak of Shadows is active, you take 40% less physical damage.

enchants.name: Glyph of Crippling Poison
enchants.tooltip: Increases the chance to inflict your target with Crippling Poison by an additional 20%.

enchants.name: Glyph of Deadly Throw
enchants.tooltip: Increases the slowing effect on Deadly Throw by 20%.

enchants.name: Glyph of Evasion
enchants.tooltip: Increases the duration of Evasion by 5 sec.

enchants.name: Glyph of Eviscerate
enchants.tooltip: Increases the critical strike chance of Eviscerate by 10%.

enchants.name: Glyph of Expose Armor
enchants.tooltip: Increases the duration of Expose Armor by 12 sec.

enchants.name: Glyph of Fan of Knives

enchants.name: Glyph of Feint

enchants.name: Glyph of Garrote

enchants.name: Glyph of Ghostly Strike
enchants.tooltip: Increases the damage dealt by Ghostly Strike by 40% and the duration of its effect by 4 sec, but increases its cooldown by 10 sec.

enchants.name: Glyph of Gouge
enchants.tooltip: Reduces the energy cost of Gouge by 15.

enchants.name: Glyph of Hemorrhage
enchants.tooltip: Your Hemorrhage criticals restore 10 energy.

enchants.name: Glyph of Hunger For Blood
enchants.tooltip: Increases the bonus damage from Hunger For Blood by 3%.

enchants.name: Glyph of Killing Spree
enchants.tooltip: Reduces the cooldown on Killing Spree by -45 sec.

enchants.name: Glyph of Mutilate
enchants.tooltip: Reduces the cost of Mutilate by 5 energy.

enchants.name: Glyph of Preparation
enchants.tooltip: Your Preparation ability also instantly resets the cooldown of Blade Flurry, Dismantle, and Kick.

enchants.name: Glyph of Rupture
enchants.tooltip: Increases the duration of Rupture by 4 sec.

enchants.name: Glyph of Sap
enchants.tooltip: Increases the duration of Sap by 20 sec.

enchants.name: Glyph of Sinister Strike
enchants.tooltip: Your Sinister Strike critical strikes have a 50% chance to add an additional combo point.

enchants.name: Glyph of Slice and Dice
enchants.tooltip: Increases the duration of Slice and Dice by 3 sec.

enchants.name: Glyph of Sprint
enchants.tooltip: Increases the movement speed of your Sprint ability by an additional 30%.

enchants.name: Glyph of Tricks of the Trade
enchants.tooltip: The bonus damage and threat redirection granted by your Tricks of the Trade ability lasts an additional 4 sec.

enchants.name: Glyph of Vigor
enchants.tooltip:
Requires Vigor
Vigor grants an additional 10 maximum energy.

enchants.name: Hastened Feint
enchants.tooltip: Reduces the cooldown of your Feint ability by 4 seconds.

enchants.name: Improved Ambush
enchants.tooltip:
Crossover Talent
Increases the critical strike chance of your Ambush ability by 50%.

This Mystic Enchant does not stack with the Improved Ambush Talent.

enchants.name: Improved Eviscerate
enchants.tooltip:
Crossover Talent
Increases the damage done by your Eviscerate ability by 20%.

This Mystic Enchant does not stack with the Improved Eviscerate Talent.

enchants.name: Improved Expose Armor
enchants.tooltip:
Crossover Talent
Reduces the energy cost of your Expose Armor ability by 10.

This Mystic Enchant does not stack with the Improved Expose Armor Talent.

enchants.name: Improved Gouge
enchants.tooltip:
Crossover Talent
Increases the effect duration of your Gouge ability by 1.5 sec.

This Mystic Enchant does not stack with the Improved Gouge Talent.

enchants.name: Improved Poisons
enchants.tooltip:
Crossover Talent
Increases the chance to apply Deadly Poison to your target by 12% and the frequency of applying Instant Poison to your target by 30%.

This Mystic Enchant does not stack with the Improved Poisons Talent.

enchants.name: Improved Sinister Strike
enchants.tooltip:
Crossover Talent
Reduces the Energy cost of your Sinister Strike ability by 5.

This Mystic Enchant does not stack with the Improved Sinister Strike Talent.

enchants.name: Improved Slice and Dice
enchants.tooltip:
Crossover Talent
Increases the duration of your Slice and Dice ability by 50%.

This Mystic Enchant does not stack with the Improved Slice and Dice Talent.

enchants.name: Initiative
enchants.tooltip:
Crossover Talent
Gives you a 100% chance to add an additional combo point to your target when using your Ambush, Garrote, or Cheap Shot ability.

This Mystic Enchant does not stack with the Initiative Talent.

enchants.name: Lethality
enchants.tooltip:
Crossover Talent
Increases the critical strike damage bonus of all combo point-generating abilities that do not require stealth by 30%.

This Mystic Enchant does not stack with the Lethality Talent.

enchants.name: Lightning Reflexes
enchants.tooltip:
Crossover Talent
Increases your Dodge chance by 6% and gives you 10% melee haste.

This Mystic Enchant does not stack with the Lightning Reflexes Talent.

enchants.name: Malice
enchants.tooltip:
Crossover Talent
Increases your critical strike chance by 5%.

This Mystic Enchant does not stack with the Malice Talent.

enchants.name: Master of Deception
enchants.tooltip:
Crossover Talent
Reduces the chance enemies have to detect you while in Stealth mode.  More effective than Master of Deception (Rank 2).

This Mystic Enchant does not stack with the Master of Deception Talent.

enchants.name: Opportunity
enchants.tooltip:
Crossover Talent
Increases the damage dealt with your Backstab, Mutilate, Garrote and Ambush abilities by 20%.

This Mystic Enchant does not stack with the Opportunity Talent.

enchants.name: Precision
enchants.tooltip:
Crossover Talent
Increases your chance to hit with weapon and poison attacks by 5%.

This Mystic Enchant does not stack with the Precision Talent.

enchants.name: Puncturing Wounds
enchants.tooltip:
Crossover Talent
Increases the critical strike chance of your Backstab ability by 30%, and the critical strike chance of your Mutilate ability by 15%.

This Mystic Enchant does not stack with the Puncturing Wounds Talent.

enchants.name: Relentless Strikes
enchants.tooltip:
Crossover Talent
Your finishing moves have a 20% chance per combo point to restore 25 energy.

This Mystic Enchant does not stack with the Relentless Strikes Talent.

enchants.name: Remorseless Attacks
enchants.tooltip:
Crossover Talent
After killing an opponent that yields experience or honor, gives you a 40% increased critical strike chance on your next Sinister Strike, Hemorrhage, Backstab, Mutilate, Ambush, or Ghostly Strike.  Lasts 20 sec.

This Mystic Enchant does not stack with the Remorseless Attacks Talent.

enchants.name: Riposte
Ruthlessness
enchants.tooltip:
Crossover Talent
Gives your melee finishing moves a 60% chance to add a combo point to your target.

This Mystic Enchant does not stack with the Ruthlessness Talent.

enchants.name: Serrated Blades
enchants.tooltip:
Crossover Talent
Causes your attacks to ignore up to 9% of your target's Armor and increases the damage dealt by your Rupture ability by 30%.

This Mystic Enchant does not stack with the Serrated Blades Talent.

enchants.name: Setup
enchants.tooltip:
Crossover Talent
Gives you a 100% chance to add a combo point to your target after dodging their attack or fully resisting one of their spells.  This cannot happen more than once per second.

This Mystic Enchant does not stack with the Setup Talent.

enchants.name: Sleight of Hand
enchants.tooltip:
Crossover Talent
Reduces the chance you are critically hit by melee and ranged attacks by 2% and increases the threat reduction of your Feint ability by 20%.

This Mystic Enchant does not stack with the Sleight of Hand Talent.

enchants.name: Vigor
enchants.tooltip:
Crossover Talent
Increases your maximum Energy by 10.

This Mystic Enchant does not stack with the Vigor Talent.

enchants.name: Vile Poisons
enchants.tooltip:
Crossover Talent
Increases the damage dealt by your poisons and Envenom ability by 20% and gives your damage over time poisons an additional 30% chance to resist dispel effects.

This Mystic Enchant does not stack with the Vile Poisons Talent.

abilities.name: Ambush
abilities.tooltipTemplate: Ambush the target, causing 319% weapon damage plus 371.25 to the target.  Must be stealthed and behind the target.  Requires a dagger in the main hand.  Awards 2 combo points.

abilities.name: Anesthetic Poison
abilities.tooltipTemplate: Coats your weapon with poison for 2 hours. Each hit has a 50% chance to deal 68 to 86 Nature damage instantly and dispel 1 Enrage effect, without generating extra threat.

abilities.name: Cheap Shot
abilities.tooltipTemplate: Stuns the target for 4 sec.  Must be stealthed.  Awards 2 combo points.

abilities.name: Crimson Tempest
abilities.tooltipTemplate:
Finishing move that slashes at the flesh of all enemies within 8 yards, dealing Physical damage and causing them to bleed per combo point:
   1 point:  9.06 physical damage and 194.81 bleed damage over 8 sec.
   2 points: 10.11 physical damage and 217.62 bleed damage over 8 sec.
   3 points: 11.17 physical damage and 240.43 bleed damage over 8 sec.
   4 points: 12.22 physical damage and 263.24 bleed damage over 8 sec.
   5 points: 13.28 physical damage and 286.05 bleed damage over 8 sec.

abilities.name: Crippling Poison
abilities.tooltipTemplate: Coats a weapon with poison that lasts for 1 hour. Each strike has a 50% chance of poisoning the enemy, slowing their movement speed by 70% for 12 sec.

abilities.name: Deadly Poison
abilities.tooltipTemplate: Coats a weapon with poison that lasts for 1 hour. Each strike has a 30% chance of poisoning the enemy for 96 Nature damage over 12 sec.  Stacks up to 5 times on a single target.   Once stacked to 5 times, each application of Deadly Poison also causes the poison on the Rogue's other weapon to apply.

abilities.name: Deadly Throw
abilities.tooltipTemplate:
Finishing move that reduces the movement of the target by 50% for 6 sec and causes increased thrown weapon damage:
   1 point  : ${59+(105*1)+30wb} - ${75+(105*1)+30WB} damage
   2 points: ${59+(105*2)+30wb} - ${75+(105*2)+30WB} damage
   3 points: ${59+(105*3)+30wb} - ${75+(105*3)+30WB} damage
   4 points: ${59+(105*4)+30wb} - ${75+(105*4)+30WB} damage
   5 points: ${59+(105*5)+30wb} - ${75+(105*5)+30WB} damage

abilities.name: Dismantle
abilities.tooltipTemplate: Disarm the enemy, removing all weapons, shield or other equipment carried for 10 sec.

abilities.name: Envenom
abilities.tooltipTemplate:
Finishing move that consumes your Deadly Poison doses on the target and deals instant poison damage.  Following the Envenom attack you have an additional 15% chance to apply Deadly Poison and a 30% increased frequency of applying Instant Poison for 1 sec plus an additional 1 sec per combo point.  One dose is consumed for each combo point:
  1 dose:  104 damage
  2 doses: 208 damage
  3 doses: 312 damage
  4 doses: 416 damage
  5 doses: 520 damage

abilities.name: Eviscerate
abilities.tooltipTemplate:
Finishing move that causes damage per combo point:
   1 point  : 224-332 damage
   2 points: 394-502 damage
   3 points: 564-672 damage
   4 points: 734-842 damage
   5 points: 904-1012 damage

abilities.name: Expose Armor
abilities.tooltipTemplate:
Finishing move that exposes the target, reducing armor by 20% and lasting longer per combo point:
   1 point  : 6 sec.
   2 points: 12 sec.
   3 points: 18 sec.
   4 points: 24 sec.
   5 points: 30 sec.

abilities.name: Garrote
abilities.tooltipTemplate: Garrote the enemy, silencing them for 3 sec causing 426 damage over 18 sec, increased by attack power.  Must be stealthed and behind the target.  Awards 1 combo point.

abilities.name: Hunger For Blood
abilities.tooltipTemplate: Enrages you, increasing all damage caused by 5%.  Requires a bleed effect to be active on the target.  Lasts 1 min.

abilities.name: Instant Poison
abilities.tooltipTemplate: Coats a weapon with poison that lasts for 1 hour. Each strike has a chance of poisoning the enemy which instantly inflicts 13 Nature damage.

abilities.name: Kidney Shot
abilities.tooltipTemplate:
Finishing move that stuns the target.  Lasts longer per combo point:
   1 point  : 2 seconds
   2 points: 3 seconds
   3 points: 4 seconds
   4 points: 5 seconds
   5 points: 6 seconds

abilities.name: Mind-numbing Poison
abilities.tooltipTemplate: Coats a weapon with poison that lasts for 1 hour. Each strike has a 50% chance of poisoning the enemy, increasing their casting time by 30% for 10 sec. Does not stack with other similar effects.

abilities.name: Mutilate
abilities.tooltipTemplate: Instantly attacks with both weapons for 100% weapon damage plus an additional 34 with each weapon.  Damage is increased by 20% against Poisoned targets.  Awards 2 combo points.

abilities.name: Poison Nova
abilities.tooltipTemplate:
Release a pulse of poison around you, dealing Nature damage per combo point.

   1 point  : 224-224 damage
   2 points: 394-394 damage
   3 points: 564-564 damage
   4 points: 734-734 damage
   5 points: 904-904 damage

Poison Nova increases the damage taken from the casters Deadly Poison, Envenom and Instant Poison by 8% for 12 sec.

@ext:This uses Instant Poison modifiers.:ext@

@ext:Usable in Cat Form.:ext@

abilities.name: Rupture
abilities.tooltipTemplate:
Finishing move that causes damage over time, increased by your attack power.  Lasts longer per combo point:
   1 point  : 272 damage over 8 secs
   2 points: 380 damage over 10 secs
   3 points: 504 damage over 12 secs
   4 points: 644 damage over 14 secs
   5 points: 800 damage over 16 secs

abilities.name: Slice and Dice
abilities.tooltipTemplate:
Finishing move that increases melee attack speed by 40%.  Lasts longer per combo point:
   1 point  : ${(9+$[0])*(100+0)/100} seconds
   2 points: ${(12+$[0])*(100+0)/100} seconds
   3 points: ${(15+$[0])*(100+0)/100} seconds
   4 points: ${(18+$[0])*(100+0)/100} seconds
   5 points: ${(21+$[0])*(100+0)/100} seconds

abilities.name: Wound Poison
abilities.tooltipTemplate: Coats a weapon with poison that lasts for 1 hour. Each strike has a chance of poisoning the enemy, causing 16 Nature damage and reducing all healing effects used on them by 50% for 15 sec. Does not stack with other similar effects.

abilities.name: Backstab
abilities.tooltipTemplate: Backstab the target, causing 150% weapon damage plus 279 to the target.  Must be behind the target.  Requires a dagger in the main hand.  Awards 1 combo point.

abilities.name: Evasion
abilities.tooltipTemplate: Increases the rogue's dodge chance by 50% and reduces the chance ranged attacks hit the rogue by 25%.  Lasts 15 sec.

abilities.name: Fan of Knives
abilities.tooltipTemplate: Instantly throw both weapons at all targets within 8 yards, causing 105% weapon damage with daggers, and 70% weapon damage with all other weapons.

abilities.name: Feint
abilities.tooltipTemplate: Performs a feint, causing no damage but lowering your threat by a large amount, making the enemy less likely to attack you.  In addition, reduces the damage you take from area of effect attacks by 50% for 6 sec.

abilities.name: Gouge
abilities.tooltipTemplate: Causes 1 damage, incapacitating the opponent for 4 sec, and turns off your attack.  Target must be facing you.  Any damage caused will revive the target.  Awards 1 combo point.

abilities.name: Kick
abilities.tooltipTemplate: A quick kick that interrupts spellcasting and prevents any spell in that school from being cast for 5 sec.

abilities.name: Killing Spree
abilities.tooltipTemplate: Step through the shadows from enemy to enemy within 10 yards, attacking an enemy every 0.5 sec with both weapons until 5 assaults are made, and increasing all damage done by 40% for the duration.  Can hit the same target multiple times.  Cannot hit invisible or stealthed targets.

abilities.name: Shiv
abilities.tooltipTemplate: Performs an instant off-hand weapon attack that automatically applies the poison from your off-hand weapon to the target.  Slower weapons require more Energy.  Shiv can not critically strike.  Awards 1 combo point.

abilities.name: Sinister Strike
abilities.tooltipTemplate: An instant strike that causes 118 damage in addition to 100% of your normal weapon damage.  Awards 1 combo point.

abilities.name: Sprint
abilities.tooltipTemplate: Increases the rogue's movement speed by 70% for 15 sec.  Does not break stealth.

abilities.name: Blind
abilities.tooltipTemplate: Blinds the target, causing it to wander disoriented for up to 10 sec.  Any damage caused will remove the effect.

abilities.name: Cloak of Shadows
abilities.tooltipTemplate: Instantly removes all existing harmful spell effects and increases your chance to resist all spells by 100% for 5 sec.  Does not remove effects that prevent you from using Cloak of Shadows.

abilities.name: Disarm Trap
abilities.tooltipTemplate: Disarm a hostile trap.

abilities.name: Distract
abilities.tooltipTemplate: Throws a distraction, attracting the attention of all nearby monsters for 10 seconds.  Does not break stealth.

abilities.name: Hemorrhage
abilities.tooltipTemplate: An instant strike that deals 110% weapon damage (159.5% if a dagger is equipped) and causes the target to hemorrhage, increasing any Physical damage dealt to the target by up to 13.  Lasts 10 charges or 15 sec.  Awards 1 combo point.

abilities.name: Pick Lock
abilities.tooltipTemplate: Allows opening of locked chests and doors.

abilities.name: Pick Pocket
abilities.tooltipTemplate: Pick the target's pocket.

abilities.name: Sap
abilities.tooltipTemplate: Incapacitates the target for up to 1 min.  Must be stealthed.  Only works on Humanoids, Beasts, Demons and Dragonkin that are not in combat.  Any damage caused will revive the target.  Only 1 target may be sapped at a time.

abilities.name: Shadow Dance
abilities.tooltipTemplate: Enter the Shadow Dance for 8 sec, allowing the use of Sap, Garrote, Ambush, Cheap Shot, Premeditation, Pickpocket and Disarm Trap regardless of being stealthed.

abilities.name: Shadowstep
abilities.tooltipTemplate: Attempts to step through the shadows and reappear behind your enemy and increases movement speed by 70% for 3 sec.  The damage of your next ability is increased by 20% and the threat caused is reduced by 50%.  Lasts 10 sec.

abilities.name: Stealth
abilities.tooltipTemplate: Allows the rogue to sneak around, but reduces your speed by 30%.  Lasts until cancelled.

abilities.name: Tricks of the Trade
abilities.tooltipTemplate: The current party or raid member becomes the target of your Tricks of the Trade.  The threat caused by your next damaging attack and all actions taken for 6 sec afterwards will be transferred to the target.  In addition, all damage caused by the target is increased by 15% during this time.

abilities.name: Vanish
abilities.tooltipTemplate: Allows the rogue to vanish from sight, entering an improved stealth mode for 10 sec.  Also breaks movement impairing effects.  More effective than Vanish (Rank 1).
